guide_page_numbering: PDF page numbers equal printed page numbers; document last revised 20 July 2023.

verified_sources.finding: GADM version 3.6, national and administrative level 2 boundaries. The guide lists 2020 in its input time-frame/downloaded column; do not describe this as a common 2020 boundary observation date.
verified_sources.xml_evidence: Process FeatureClassToFeatureClass input path ends with admin_bnds/GADM/gadm36.shp.

verified_sources.finding: WorldPop Unconstrained Individual Countries 2020 UN Adjusted, 100 m, adjusted to UN World Population Prospects 2019 Revision country estimates.
GHSL GHS-SMOD R2019A, 2015 settlement grid, 1 km. Narrative page 4 abbreviates release as R2019; Table 1 gives R2019A.
verified_sources.uncertainty: The guide does not enumerate the individual GHS-SMOD classes used as rural; do not infer a national statutory rural definition.

verified_sources.finding: OpenStreetMap data downloaded 31 March 2022 from osmdata.xyz.
Road condition was inferred from OSM Highway, Access and Surface tags; this is a modelled proxy, not a field survey of seasonal road usability.

RAI = 100 × rural population within the 2 km road buffer / total rural population, calculated per source admin2 unit. Units percent (0–100). No further population weighting is required to display each district percentage.
verified_sources.xml_evidence: Process CalculateField sets adm2_pct_r using (!adm2_r_buf! / !adm2_rural!) * 100; later metadata renames adm2_pct_r to RAIpct and then SDG911pct.
verified_sources.codebook_mismatch: Guide labels percentage RAI_Pct; shipped source shapefile field is SDG911pct.

verified_sources.finding: The source uses 2 km road buffers and intersects them with rural zones. This is geographic proximity rather than measured journey time or road-network walking distance.
verified_sources.inference: The guide explicitly says buffers; interpreting them as proximity rather than route travel is an inference from that procedure.

verified_sources.finding: OSM mapping and classification/tag completeness vary within and between countries; GADM resolution varies by country.
2023 is the dataset release label. It combines 2020 population, 2015 settlement classification and roads downloaded in March 2022, so it should not be called measured 2023 access.

-9997.meaning: Population percent error exceeds 5%; indicator not reported.

-9998.meaning: Zero population denominator; indicator cannot be computed.

-9999.meaning: Missing input data or inaccurate numerator; indicator cannot be computed.

sole_guide_verbatim_snippet.text: population value of zero in the denominator

recommended_rules: Keep sentinel codes and original source values in the audit table; render all negative error-code indicators as no data, not low access.
If denominator is null or zero, do not turn null population values into zero or treat an apparent percentage zero as valid access.
A percentage of zero is valid only where the indicator is nonnegative and the rural denominator is positive; a zero numerator then implies 0% within 2 km.

Use denominator population for aggregation only after confirming source scope and avoiding overlapping or duplicated units. Aggregate as sum(numerator)/sum(denominator), multiplied by 100; do not average the district percentages.

unknown_8.interpretation: Undefined rural access because the source rural population denominator is zero. The supplied spreadsheet blank populations and displayed zero must be replaced by a no-data classification, with provenance retained.

uploaded_source_observations.note: These are direct read-only observations of the uploaded subset, not claims about every record in the global archive.

xml_cautions: Both shipped XML files retain internal 2022 dataset item/title/path names; national XML also retains an earlier count of 45,162 subnational units. The 2023 guide says 45,073 units. Treat those XML titles/counts as stale lineage metadata; they do not establish a different release or change the supplied 2023 archive identity.
Metadata indicates source field names can change across processing steps; use actual shipped schema and validated values rather than assuming guide aliases exactly match shapefile field names.

unknown_names.finding: The uploaded source already stores literal unknown 1 through unknown 8 labels in Kenya; these labels are source values, not names to be guessed.
unknown_names.recommended_label: Unnamed source unit (retain the original unknown label and source record ID in details); any identification against another boundary dataset requires a documented geometry match.

recommended_user_facing_wording.legend_detail: Rural population within 2 km of a road classified as likely all-season
recommended_user_facing_wording.method_short: NASA SEDAC Rural Access Index, 2023 release. District values use 2020 WorldPop rural population and OSM roads downloaded in March 2022, with GADM v3.6 source boundaries.
recommended_user_facing_wording.method_extended: Share of the modelled rural population within 2 km of an OSM road classified as likely all-season, using WorldPop 2020 population, GHSL 2015 settlement classification and GADM v3.6 units. The 2023 release measures proximity; road tagging and coverage can affect estimates. Grey units have no computable value.
recommended_user_facing_wording.source_attribution: CIESIN, Columbia University. 2023. SDG Indicator 9.1.1: Rural Access Index (RAI), 2023 Release. NASA SEDAC. DOI: 10.7927/fcre-m572.
do_not_say: All figures refer to current administrative boundaries
10 km is a standard local catchment

outstanding_uncertainties: Source GADM v3.6 units do not automatically match the map’s OCHA admin2 polygons. Confirm geometry correspondence before colouring current units.
Exact/Partial/Proxy labels in the supplied spreadsheet have no accompanying codebook. Their intended treatment must not be invented.
The guide does not explain the substantive identity of literal unknown Kenyan unit labels.
The guide’s input table combines time frame and downloaded timing in one header; do not assign a single observation year to every boundary.
